verdicts.reason: A is broken. The white card is left empty and the title sits outside it, under the card, where the rose ornaments collide with its bottom edge. The hydrangea cluster is split into floating fragments far above the card, the divider line is stranded at the bottom of the canvas, and nearly half the story is dead space. B keeps the title and divider inside the card, so it still reads as the same design. But its hydrangeas are chopped into scattered pieces inside the card instead of crowning it, the roses float in a row above the title instead of flanking it, and the card is a small band in the middle with large empty areas above and below.
